summary: @or-sdk/hitl preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` uses `_0x`-style identifier obfuscation and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip` (falling back to a system `bun`), then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [<pkg>/math_init.js])`. The bundled `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` file with heavy obfuscation: a large mixed numeric/string constant array plus a rotator function `WV8StW` that permutes the array at load. The package's advertised purpose is a HITL REST API SDK, which has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime, no need for a native `math_init.js`, and no need to run either at install time. The opaque payload is handed to a freshly-downloaded interpreter with no hash or signature verification, and the setup script's obfuscation actively hides the flow. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: a second JS runtime is fetched specifically to execute a sibling file that Node-based scanners typically will not inspect, executing on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
